header.running_head: The Chapter Concerning Da'wah Towards Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ

blocks.text: then the Arabs would say that we bowed before you. This will only be during the following year." Consequently, this was written (that the Muslims will be allowed to perform Umrah during the following year). (Proposing the next clause) Suhayl bin Amr said, "Should any man from our ranks join you, he would be returned to us even though he follows your religion." The Muslims exclaimed, "Subhaanallaah! How can he be returned to the Mushrikeen when he has come as a Muslim?"

Negotiations were still underway when Hadhrat Abu Jandal (RA) the son of Suhayl bin Amr arrived there chained in fetters. He had just left the lower part of Makkah and handed himself over to the Muslims. "This man O Muhammad," said Suhayl bin Amr, "is the first person I am demanding that you return to me in accordance with the treaty." "But we have not yet concluded the treaty," said Rasulullaah ﷺ. Suhayl bin Amr adamantly said, "Then I shall never negotiate any treaty with you!" Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "At least leave him to me." "I shall never leave him to you!" Suhayl bin Amr bellowed. "Why not? I am sure you can," Rasulullaah ﷺ requested. "I shall not," Suhayl bin Amr said stubbornly. Mikraz however said, "We shall not leave him to you." Hadhrat Abu Jandal (RA) addressed the Muslim saying, "O gathering of Muslim! Why should I be returned to the Mushrikeen when I have come as a Muslim? Have you not seen how I have suffered?" Hadhrat Abu Jandal (RA) had endured severe torture at the hands of the Mushrikeen.
Hadhrat Umar (RA) then approached Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "Are you not the true Nabi of Allaah?" "I am indeed," replied Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked further, "Are we not on the truth and our enemies on falsehood?" "Certainly," said Rasulullaah ﷺ. "Then," asked Hadhrat Umar (RA), "why do we have to submit?" Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "I am certainly the Rasool of Allaah. I cannot disobey Him and He is my Helper." Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "Did you not tell us that we shall arrive at the Kabah and perform Tawaaf around it?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Indeed I did but did I tell you that it would be this year?" "No," said Hadhrat Umar (RA). "Then you shall certainly arrive there and perform Tawaaf around it," Rasulullaah ﷺ assured him.
Hadhrat Umar (RA) then approached Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and asked him, "Is he not the true Nabi of Allaah?" "He is indeed," replied Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked further, "Are we not on the truth and our enemies on falsehood?" "Certainly," said Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). "Then," asked Hadhrat Umar (RA), "why do we have to submit?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said to him, "O person! He is certainly the Rasool of Allaah. He cannot disobey Allaah and Allaah is his Helper." Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "Did Rasulullaah ﷺ not tell us that we shall arrive at the Kabah and perform Tawaaf around it?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "He did indeed, but did he tell you that it would be this year?" "No," said Hadhrat Umar (RA).
